design_identity.archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST + ARCHETYPE 2: THE PERFORMANCE PRO
design_identity.design_goal: Transform flat, low-contrast, cognitive-heavy internal ERP screens into a high-density, sharp, multi-layered tactical command center with crystal-clear visual hierarchy, high contrast cards against cool canvas, precise tabular figures, and cognitive status affordances.

color_system.theme_strategy: Crisp Cool Slate Canvas with Stark Pure White Elevated Cards, Crisp 1px Tinted Borders, and High-Affordance Semantic Badges
color_system.contrast_fix_explanation: The previous background (36 33% 98% warm beige) was visually indistinguishable from white cards, creating a muddy flat illusion. The new canvas is a cool slate-tinted background (220 20% 97%) paired with pure white cards (0 0% 100%), subtle 1px slate borders (215 16% 87%), and crisp ambient shadows (shadow-sm to shadow-md).

text_formatting_rules: Rule 1: Always enforce `max-w-3xl` or `max-w-prose` on description lines to prevent wide 3-line text stretch.
Rule 2: Money amounts must use `tabular-nums text-right font-mono font-semibold` inside tables and KPI cards.
Rule 3: Heading jumps must be smooth (e.g. Page title text-2xl -> Section text-lg -> Card text-sm).
Rule 4: All labels and table column headers must use uppercase tracking-wider (`uppercase tracking-wider text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-500`).

hierarchy_rules: 1. Action Primacy: Each view or section MUST have at most ONE dominant Primary Button (sky-800 solid blue with white text). Secondary actions must use outline or secondary neutral style.
2. Destructive Safeguard: Destructive actions (delete, reject, revoke) must be styled in solid rose red and prompt a Confirmation Modal before execution.
3. Critical Status Affordance: Urgent items (e.g., late cash advances, overdue SPK opname, blocked leads) must show a glowing/pulsing red dot badge and a top red line accent on cards or table rows.

4. Depth Strategy: Combine a crisp 1px border (`border-slate-200`) with elevated card background (`bg-white`) and subtle shadow (`shadow-xs` / `shadow-sm`) over the slate-tinted canvas background (`bg-slate-100`). This creates clear optical layers: Canvas (Layer 0) -> Card (Layer 1) -> Modal/Popover (Layer 2).

rules: 1. Use micro-animations on interactive states: hover, focus, active press (`active:scale-[0.98]`).
2. Row hover transitions in tables must use fast transition `transition-colors duration-150` with high-contrast hover tint (`hover:bg-sky-50/50`).
3. All focus states must display high-contrast visible focus rings (`focus:ring-2 focus:ring-sky-500 focus:ring-offset-2`).
4. Keep layout shift durations between 150ms and 200ms ease-out for maximum responsiveness without lag.
